integrity: A proved formula based on a complete two-regular auxiliary-graph characterization and cyclic gap enumeration; exact symbolic determinant and complete finite enumeration through n=16 were reproduced. No external independent proof audit.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary closed-neighborhood identification on labelled complements of simple cycles with n at least 5; no optimal-code reconfiguration theorem or result for complements of arbitrary 2-regular graphs. Prior full text of the 2020 minimum-identifying-code paper unavailable, so publication priority is provisional.
title: Complete identifying-code polynomial of complements of cycles
